posts.post_caption:
✨ A NEW SPACE IS COMING! ✨

I’m so excited to announce that I’ll be moving into a new Micro Salon location! 

As much as I’ve loved my current space and all the memories we’ve made there, it’s time for a fresh start in a newer, more updated building. This move is all about creating a space that is more reliable, comfortable, and relaxing for each and every one of my clients.

My biggest priority has always been making sure you feel comfortable, cared for, and confident when you’re sitting in my chair. I truly love what I do, and I’m so grateful that I get to help people feel their absolute best.

I can’t wait to continue serving my amazing clients and the Grand Junction community in this new space! More details about the new location are coming soon!

The best ways you can support my small business during this transition are to pre book your appointments and tell all your friends! 

Thank you for continuing to support me and allowing me to do what I love every day. I can’t wait for you all to see the new space!
